title: Best Areas to Buy Property in Phuket: Area Guide
description: Compare Phuket areas for buyers: Rawai, Nai Harn, Kata, Karon, Kamala, Bang Tao, Laguna and Nai Yang, with links to projects in each.
h1: Best Areas to Buy Property in Phuket
sub: A buyer’s comparison of the main areas
intro: There is no single best area. The right one depends on whether you want to live there, rent the unit out, or buy for the long term. Here are the main areas where we list projects, with what each is known for. For current projects and prices, open the linked location page.

sections.h2: South: Rawai, Nai Harn and Chalong
p: The south has a settled, residential feel with a larger year-round community. Nai Harn has a well-known beach and lake and Rawai has a local seafront with restaurants. It suits buyers who plan to live in Phuket.
These are busy west-coast beach towns with plenty of restaurants, shops and visitor traffic. Buyers often consider them for holiday use and rental potential, though rental income is never guaranteed.

Kamala is a smaller, quieter west-coast area with a mix of hillside and beach projects. Patong is the island’s busiest nightlife and tourism centre, which brings convenience and noise in equal measure.

sections.h2: Bang Tao, Cherng Talay and Laguna
p: The north-west is known for the Laguna resort cluster, Bang Tao beach, international schools and larger villa and condo developments. It suits families and buyers who want a resort-style setting.
Near the airport and the national park, with long quiet beaches and a lower density of development. It suits buyers who want space and easy airport access.

ul: Decide your use: living, holiday, rental or long-term hold.
Visit at different times of year; the monsoon season changes beaches and traffic.
Check distances: beach, hospital, supermarket and school are listed under Nearby on each project page.
Compare the ownership type and the payment plan, not only the price.

disclaimer: General information only, not legal or tax advice, and rules can change. Confirm every point with a licensed Thai lawyer and the Land Department before you pay a deposit.

faq.q: Which area is best for rental income?
faq.a: No area guarantees income. Rental depends on building rules, season, price and management. Check the rules of the specific building.

faq.q: Which area is closest to the airport?
faq.a: Nai Yang and Mai Khao are the closest of the areas we list.
